proposal.summary: Cross-site scripting vulnerability exists in CONPROSYS HMI System (CHS) versions prior to 3.5.3.
proposal.affected_product: CONPROSYS HMI System (CHS) versions prior to 3.5.3
proposal.cwe_quote: Cross-site scripting vulnerability exists in CONPROSYS HMI System (CHS) versions prior to 3.5.3.

AV.quote: If a user who can access the affected product with an administrative privilege configures specially crafted settings, an arbitrary script may be executed on the web browser of the other user.

PR.quote: If a user who can access the affected product with an administrative privilege configures specially crafted settings.

UI.quote: an arbitrary script may be executed on the web browser of the other user who is accessing the affected product with an administrative privilege.

C.quote: an arbitrary script may be executed on the web browser of the other user.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Investigate and patch the vulnerability in affected versions.
